name: @kontor-mcp/client
stderr:
Usage: kontor-agent [options] [command]

Reference MCP client for Kontor MCP — introspection, one-shot audit, agent chat.

Options:
  -V, --version           output the version number
  --stdio [command...]    spawn the server over stdio (default: the bundled
                          @kontor-mcp/server)
  --url <url>             Streamable HTTP endpoint, e.g.
                          http://127.0.0.1:3333/mcp
  --token <token>         bearer token for --url (default: $KONTOR_AUTH_TOKEN)
  -h, --help              display help for command

Commands:
  tools                   list tools, resources and prompts with their schemas
                          (no LLM)
  audit [options] <file>  audit one invoice via audit_invoice (no LLM, no API
                          key); exit 0 accept · 1 review · 2 reject · 3 error
  chat [options]          agent loop: Anthropic Messages API with all Kontor
                          tools bridged in; prints every tool call
  help [command]          display help for command
